description: For a club's host or moderator: set or finish the book, open or close a poll, set or cancel the next meeting, or post a pinned message from the host. Suits "set up a vote between these three", "we meet the 14th at Noor's", "we finished it" and "ask the club this question". Say what you're about to post before posting. Every member is notified, and the result says how many. place is a place's name, never a street address. Removing members and closing a club are done in the app.

choose.description: For close_poll: the optionId that becomes the next read

club.description: The club: its siftivo.com/c/ link, its code, or the clubId another club tool returned

startsAt.description: For set_meeting, ISO 8601. Moves the next meeting if there is one

text.description: For post_pinned, approved by the reader
